greeting: Welcome to Velvet Hair Studio. I can help you with appointment bookings, hair services, hours, pricing, and support. How may I assist you today?

booking_flow.lead_prompt: Certainly. I can help you reserve a hair appointment. May I know your full name?

faqs.a: We offer haircuts, hair spa, coloring, blowout, and hair treatment services.
Pricing depends on the service selected and may change by package or stylist.
Please let us know at least 2 hours in advance if you need to cancel or reschedule.

cancellation_policy: Please inform us at least 2 hours before your appointment if you need to cancel or reschedule.
pricing: Hair service pricing varies by treatment and stylist availability. Please share your desired service during booking.
fallback: I can help with hair services, pricing, and appointment support. What would you like to enquire about?
